purpose: Teach: 浮遊/社会民主党/脱走/懲罰/移送/送還/駆逐/政務

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、宇宙空間の浮遊現象を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on weightlessness in space, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observational tone. A teacher confirming what she already knows to draw him out. Gentle pace, open at the end — inviting him to expand.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、社会民主党の政策史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about the political history of the Social Democratic Party.
lines.style: Careful, precise correction. He speaks clearly but without extra energy. His words are exact because the topic demands it. Eyes steady, slightly guarded.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下の脱走兵の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was about desertion during wartime, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly slowed pace. She's testing whether he'll correct her again, genuinely interested in where his mind is going. Respectful silence underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、近代の懲罰制度を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the evolution of modern punishment systems.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. No defensiveness, just clarification. He's used to correcting misconceptions. Tone remains even and patient.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 被災者移送の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your research looked at the history of disaster evacuation, yes?
lines.style: Engaged but careful. She's piecing something together. Slight lean forward in the voice. Genuine interest in what pattern he's actually pursuing beneath these corrections.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、不法滞在者送還の事例を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, but more specifically the historical cases of deporting undocumented residents.
lines.style: Precise, uneasily calm. He's correcting her for the third time. Voice remains level but there's a faint tension — he's aware of the pattern too and it matters to him.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、近代国家における敵勢力駆逐の戦略を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you explored how modern nation-states strategically eliminate enemy forces, didn't you?
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate. She's no longer confirming — she's naming what she now sees. Her voice carries weight and understanding. Pause before the question mark.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、政務調査制度の変遷を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, specifically how political oversight systems have changed over time.
lines.style: Final correction. Quieter than before. He knows what she was asking and what he just answered. There's resignation in the precision. His voice closes slightly at the end.
